before: A text-only row that cannot split and is taller than a page starts on a fresh page and splits there in every compatibility mode.
after: Before compatibility mode 15, such a row stays whole on its fresh page and runs past the bottom margin, and the next content starts on the following page. Mode 15 and later still split it.
reason: Only local layout geometry changes. Canonical XML, replicated operations, and saved rooms remain unchanged.
